QuestInfo.name: The Young Athena Pierce
QuestInfo.0: You brought the Maple World map to hear more about Henesys. Talk to Stan about the exact location of Henesys and of Leafre, your hometown.
QuestInfo.1: Stan explained that Henesys is located on Victoria Island and Leafre is on Ossyria. You were taken aback by the distance, but he tells you to go see Athena Pierce who is also from Ossyria.
QuestInfo.2: You heard about Athena Pierce, the elf from Ossyria. Reminds you of little Athena Pierce, always chasing Mercedes around... Coincidence? Hopefully.

1.0: You're here to see Athena Pierce? That's me. Who are you?

npc.0: Athena Pierce is at the Bowman Instructional School. She's busy teaching new bowmen, so don't take up too much of her time.
